notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Silent Hill f" or "Silent Hill F". silenthill.fandom.com answers the API with about 115 linked articles, including "Ebisugaoka", "Hinako Shimizu", "Shimizu Residence", "Omamori" and "UFO Ending"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "NOCE" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2947440 as "SILENT HILL f". 41 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden; all of them sit in the story chapter, even though some (low unlock rates of 5 to 20%) are probably endings or side events rather than plain story steps. Action and puzzle difficulty are set separately, so each has its own chapter.
